hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */client/src/*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/client/node_modules/.bin/prettier" --write --ignore-unknown "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 && printf '{"systemMessage":"Prettier formatted %s","suppressOutput":true}\n' "${f##*/}"; } 2>/dev/null || true
